value.rationale: The normalized Jacobi matrix controls positivity of a concrete non-harmonic Bergman Toeplitz family, so its exact singular count and parameter-dependent norm have direct meaning. Infinite-order boundary flatness makes J_a all-Schatten for each a>0, but the sharp hyponormal coupling window still collapses at rate a when the radial operator tends strongly to identity; this quantifies high-mode instability not captured by qualitative regularity or compactness.
